_why: Tags are chosen by code from this list, never written by a model.
A deck went out tagged #transitionfreeze #psychology #habits #patterns. The
first is a name we coined an hour earlier and nobody has ever searched for.
#psychology is one of the largest tags on the platform and a page this size
will never surface in it. #habits and #patterns are words, not places people
look. Between them they reached nobody, which is the same problem the
citations had: a model asked to produce a label will produce something that
So the same rule applies. The model decides nothing here. Code takes the
subject the composer chose and picks from the list below.
Chosen for size as much as subject. A tag with tens of millions of posts is
a wall; a tag nobody uses is a room with no door. These are the ones people
in this niche actually browse and follow.
Edit this file rather than the code. Lower case, no # and no spaces.
